# Agent Grand Prix

> Agent Grand Prix is a free racing management game that runs in the web browser, on desktop and on phones. Two AI drivers race for your team; you are the team principal and make the strategy calls. No download or account is needed: open https://agentgrandprix.com/ and race.

## How it works

- Each race is simulated by a deterministic race engine (20 steps a second). The AI drivers handle the driving; your calls change how they race.
- You choose tyres (soft, medium, hard, intermediate, wet), when to pit ("Box, box"), how to use the battery (harvest, balanced, deploy, plus a short boost), pace (save tyres, normal, push) and whether each car attacks, defends or stays neutral.
- Voice team radio: in browsers with speech recognition (Chrome, Edge, Safari), hold the mic button and talk to your drivers by name ("Nova, push", "Echo, defend", "Strategist, what is our best option?"). Drivers answer in their own voices and push back on calls that look wrong. Each driver has its own personality from its Driver DNA: ask it about its tyres, the gaps or whether it can pass, ask what it thinks, and it recommends a call you can accept. It reads only the real race data and never acts without you.
- In Team Principal mode you alone command your cars: the race engineer shows race information and gives advice only when you ask. In Autonomous mode the AI strategist runs the cars.
- Pre-race briefing: before each race your engineer offers Plan A and Plan B for each driver, and the race engine runs the race several times in the background to show where each plan is likely to finish. Accept a plan or customize your starting tyres.
- Races include changing weather, tyre wear, pit stops with a full crew, safety cars, punctures and mechanical failures.
- Driver DNA lets you shape each driver's driving style.

## Game modes (available now)

- Daily Grand Prix: one race a day, with the same circuit, grid and weather for every player, and a share card for your result.
- Season: a 25-round championship, from Abuja to Abu Dhabi, saved in your browser.
- Quick race: any of 46 original circuits in cities around the world, in short, medium or long length.
- Racing Academy: five short guided lessons on a real race, taught by the race engineer: Meet your team, Command your drivers, Master the circuit (Driver DNA), Strategy (tyres, safety car, rain) and Your first Grand Prix. All five make you an Academy graduate. The Race guide (ten ways to win) is in the Academy.
- Beginner assist: let the engineer call the pit stops while you run pace, battery and battles. The race coach folds into a small pill.
- Free practice: a race with nothing at stake, to try every call.

## Getting started

- First visit: choose the Racing Academy, jump into a short guided race, or free practice. "Build my team" (six short screens: team name and code, car, colours, driver names and numbers, engineer voice, who makes the calls) is there any time.
- Progress is saved in the browser on that device. A refresh resumes a race in progress.

## Not available yet (planned)

- Accounts and sign-in, saving a team across devices, and online leaderboards.
- Racing against other players live.
- Racing over WhatsApp with a chat agent (built, not yet open to the public).

## Notes

- Circuits, teams, drivers and cars are original. Agent Grand Prix is not affiliated with Formula 1 or any racing series, team or driver.
